cell_type_or_model: primary CD4 T cells and fibroblast comparator systems
assay_or_perturbation: TNF-alpha stimulation; Fas promoter mapping; RelA/c-Rel/p50 knockout comparisons
evidence_summary: TNF-alpha-induced Fas expression depended on RelA-containing NF-kB complexes at defined promoter sites in the studied systems.
limitations: Cell-type-dependent redundancy was observed in T cells; this does not establish SCI receiver-cell behavior.

cell_type_or_model: TNF time course with NF-kB inhibition; microarray; qPCR; EMSA; ChIP
evidence_confidence: TNF stimulation induced a broad NF-kB-dependent gene network and ChIP supported direct NF-kB/RelA binding at selected promoters.
evidence_summary: The cell-line context and selected direct targets are not SCI-specific and do not resolve TNFR1 versus TNFR2 contribution.

cell_type_or_model: primary human conventional T cells and regulatory T cells
assay_or_perturbation: TNF or TNFR2-selective DARPin 18; RNA-seq; immunoblot; RelB nuclear translocation; SN52 inhibition
evidence_summary: TNFR2 ligation induced NFKB2 and RELB transcription, increased p100/RelB and promoted RelB nuclear translocation; noncanonical inhibition reduced the proliferative response.
limitations: The model is human T-reg biology rather than SCI and the study does not establish a single downstream target gene in injured CNS cells.

cell_type_or_model: inflamed secondary lymphoid organs; MEFs; LTbetaR-stimulated stromal comparator
assay_or_perturbation: TNF treatment; qRT-PCR; p100/p52 immunoblot; Nfkb2 knockout
evidence_summary: TNF induced Nfkb2/p100 and inhibited NIK-dependent noncanonical NF-kB signaling in LTbetaR-stimulated cells; p100 loss alleviated the TNF-mediated inhibition.
limitations: The exact TNFR1/TNFR2 receptor assignment is not resolved and the system is not an SCI receiver-cell model.
